text:
marco (PM): sketching a commercial path for InsureCo — they want a mid-tier between Hosted and Dedicated: per-route soft reservations, minute-based priority packs, and a pilot SLA-credit mechanic. can we scope what’s doable without Dedicated?
zoe (Sales): InsureCo is comfortable with a monthly commit but will not take reserved GPUs. must-have: predictable capacity for two high-throughput routes and an explicit remedy if latency or throughput degrades.
todd (Pricing): product levers: per-route soft QPS buckets billed per-minute, prepaid/on-demand priority-minute packs, and time-boxed surge windows. recommend a per-customer monthly cap + emergency shutoff to limit spend and abuse. will model unit-econ after eng delta.
omar (Eng): feasible paths: runtime token-buckets per-route + a priority path; KV prefix pinning is an MVP but requires memory caps and eviction policy. true isolation (no noisy neighbors) requires Dedicated. also need a low-latency billing emitter for minute consumption.
rachel (Legal): if we promise credits we must define measurement windows, a deterministic credit calc, caps (<=20% of monthly commit), and carve-outs (maintenance, force majeure, abuse). customer also flagged EU data residency — addendum required.
marco (PM): propose a 4-week field pilot "lane-minutes beta" with guardrails: - route-level soft buckets (configurable) - purchasable priority-minute packs - automatic fallback to baseline model when tokens exhausted - SLA credit = sum(minutes where p99 > target) * credit_unit, capped at 20% of monthly commit. please flag blockers.
todd (Pricing): +1 from pricing; will supply price bands (per-1k minutes) once eng provides cost delta. add a spend cap and emergency throttle for safety.
zoe (Sales): sales +1. I will get written pilot acceptance and the two route_ids from InsureCo today.
omar (Eng): eng acceptance criteria: 1) runtime priority flag + per-route token bucket 2) KV pinning MVP with mem limits 3) feature-flag rollout and canary 4) billing emitter for near-real-time minute accounting. estimate: spike 10 working days, pilot build 2 sprints.
rachel (Legal): I'll draft a compact pilot addendum within 3 business days including credit formula and EU clause.
ops-bot: reminder set: "lane-minutes pilot kickoff" 2026-05-25 15:00 UTC
marco (PM): actions: omar spike + design doc (10d), rachel draft pilot addendum (3d), todd pricing bands (5d), zoe secure signed pilot acceptance (1d). reconvene after spike. :thumbsup:
